intro: Woods at Four Points is a small subdivision in 78726, close to the Preserve at Four Points in northwest Austin. CleanzATX cleans windows here, and Tyler handles quotes personally by text.

sections.h2: What Woods at Four Points homes are like
paragraphs: This is a small subdivision that sits near the Preserve at Four Points, with homes priced from about $500,000 to $800,000. There is no gate and no HOA on our list. The setting is the Four Points hills, with rolling ground and plenty of native trees around the lots.
We do not claim to know every plan here, so we go by what you tell us. A short text with a photo and a rough square footage is enough for a firm quote.

sections.h2: What Woods at Four Points windows deal with
paragraphs: The name says what to expect. Trees mean pollen, webs and leaf litter. Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April coat the glass, and shaded sides stay damp and attract grime.

Sprinklers on small lawns spray the lowest panes and leave white mineral spots. On sloped ground, windows facing downhill sit higher than they look from the street, which makes them hard to reach by ladder.

sections.h2: How we work Woods at Four Points
paragraphs: We often visit Woods and the Preserve on the same day, so booking close to a neighbor helps. Poles reach up to three stories from the ground, which handles downhill windows without ladders on slopes. Screens come off for hand cleaning, and tracks get brushed out. If siding is green or dusty from the trees, a house soft wash from $0.20 per square foot ($400 minimum) cleans it without damage.
For a 2,400 square foot home, expect about $240 for exterior windows and roughly two hours on site. Adding the interior at $15 a window brings it to around $360 for 24 windows.

why: Close to the Preserve, so nearby homes share a single trip.
Downhill windows are reached from the ground, not from ladders on a slope.
Tree cover webs and leaf litter come out of screens and tracks.

faq.q: How do I know what my window count is?
faq.a: Text us a photo of each side, or your square footage. Homes average about 10 windows per 1,000 square feet, which gets a quote started.

faq.q: Is Woods at Four Points near your other jobs?
faq.a: Yes. It is next to the Preserve at Four Points in 78726, and we group homes nearby when we can. Most visits happen inside two weeks.

faq.q: Do trees make windows get dirty faster?
faq.a: Yes. Pollen, sap, webs and leaves all land on glass and screens. Trees also keep the shaded side damp, so grime holds longer without a regular cleaning.

faq.q: Can you clean the screens at the same time?
faq.a: Yes, at $5 each, or $10 for full screens and $15 for solar screens. Plans at Triannual and above include a yearly free screen cleaning.

faq.q: Does rain right after a visit ruin the job?
faq.a: On Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months plans, the 7 day rain guarantee covers it. On any job, text us a photo within 7 days and we come back free when in the area.
